sets.title: Basket pricing clones that CAN be unified via parameterization
sets.description: Three pricing functions that differ only in discount rate and type literal values. These CAN be unified by introducing a rate parameter.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Pricing\Unified;

/**
 * Unified basket pricing — rate and type are now parameters
 */
class BasketPricing
{
    public function calculatePrice(float $amount, float $rate, string $type): array
    {
        $discount = $amount * $rate;
        $discounted = $amount - $discount;
        $tax = $discounted * 0.08;
        $total = $discounted + $tax;

        return [
            'original' => $amount,
            'discount' => $discount,
            'discounted' => $discounted,
            'tax' => $tax,
            'total' => $total,
            'type' => $type,
        ];
    }
}
